answer: Each nebula is a forged identity. The reef is the register where rows are anchored, and a row counts only when attestations span three separate branches: each branch signs one row ever, so clones collide. Vine is the stake the attacker burns for each signature, minted only by honest trade; every branch that signs a fake is expunged, so willing branches thin out: a thousand clones need thousands of fresh branches, and each costs more vine than the last. One row needs its whole quorum, so no clone splits the bill. It breaks if one branch can seal a row, or if vine is minted on demand.
